column1: # Explicit dispositions for current `output/<driver>` roots whose Cargo producer is absent.
#   evidence     repository-relative evidence file; required and existing for `historical`
#   note         concise reason or reconstruction boundary
# A `live` orphan is always a closure failure: live evidence must have a Cargo producer. A
# `historical` orphan is admitted only when its evidence reference exists. Rows may remain after
# the corresponding ignored output has departed, so deletion does not erase its disposition.
